% Adapted from the TeX Live pgfplotstable manual's inline table examples.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\begin{document}
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{
year,vehicles,share
2021,642,2.1
2022,904,2.8
2023,1402,4.3
}\electricvehicles
\pgfplotstabletypeset[
  columns={year,vehicles},
  columns/year/.style={column name=Year},
  columns/vehicles/.style={column name=Vehicles}
]\electricvehicles
\end{document}
